summary: I tested Landline to Texting (Hosted SMS) end to end in the DRY-RUN preview: the backend API, the web UI (light and dark modes, desktop and mobile), the inbound-to-Inbox reply, the bot and the promo copy. Backend: 10 of 11 pytest cases pass. These all work: prices and list, eligibility checks (+1 accepted, +44 rejected, duplicate numbers rejected), code and no-code payments, sending the code by text and by call with the preview toast, wrong code vs 123456, the LOA preview PDF, document checks (consent, non-PDF bill, missing fields, missing file), submit moving to review, auto-activation about 60 s later, cancel with refund and no double refund, 402 on insufficient balance, cross-account access returning 400/404, and sending texts ($0.05 charge, over 160 characters blocked, bad number and empty text blocked). Monthly billing works: renewal charges $50, an empty wallet pauses the number and blocks sending with the monthly-fee message, and the number turns back on after a top-up once retryAt passes. Inbound via onInbound creates a webNotifications item (kind sms, meta.hosted), the Inbox reply sends from the hosted number and charges $0.05, and unknown numbers return false. Regular Inbox SMS reply, the dashboard and the wallet still work. The bot has no Hosted SMS menu (only the swipe-reply hook). The promo copy for web_cloudivr has the Landline to Texting hook and line in en, fr, zh and hi, and no web_cloudivr variant fails the promo copy rules. UI: every listed flow worked through Playwright. 1 real failure: the LOA build returns 500 for non-Latin names. I also found several minor UX issues.

critical.issue: buildLoa uses pdf-lib StandardFonts (WinAnsi only). Any holder field with non-Latin characters (e.g. name 'José 王伟', Hindi, Cyrillic, emoji) throws 'WinAnsi cannot encode "王"', so the preview returns 500 and documents can't be submitted. The UI ships in zh/hi, so these users get stuck at the documents step after paying $300–$500. Fix: embed a Unicode TTF via @pdf-lib/fontkit, or transliterate/strip characters WinAnsi can't encode, and validate the fields with a clear 400.

minor.issue: check() then debit then insertOne has no unique guard, so 2 concurrent POST /hosted-sms calls for the same number can both pass and charge twice. Add a unique partial index on phoneNumber for live statuses, or an atomic upsert. Also, if insertOne fails after the debit, nothing refunds the wallet.

The cancel notification reads '❌ Texting for +1… couldn’t be set up. Cancelled by you — refunded to your wallet. $500 was refunded to your wallet.' The refund is stated twice, and 'couldn't be set up' is wrong wording for a cancel the user chose.

The 'Open texts' link on a hosted inbound SMS goes to /app/numbers because hosted numbers aren't in the user's numbers. It should go to /app/texting. Hosted status notices (activated, paused, refunded) have no link.
'Refund · Landline to Texting' has no phone number, unlike the setup line. 'Text sent · +1…' doesn't say it came from Landline to Texting.

ui_bugs.component: Texting pages (NewSetup pay, Thread send, CancelButton)
ui_bugs.issue: The topbar balance doesn't refresh after paying, sending or cancelling. It stayed at $1099.90 after a $300 payment until the 30 s poll. Call useShell().refreshSummary() after each wallet change.
The message list doesn't scroll to the newest message (newest is at the bottom of a max-h-80 box). After sending, the new message sits below the fold.
The counter says 'uses 1 text from your plan', but hosted replies cost $0.05 from the wallet.

issues: Hardcoded bg-[#1a1a1a] and text-[#d4d4d8] render correctly in both themes (CSS remaps them), so there is no contrast problem. The LOA preview's blob URL is never revoked (small leak).

action_items: Fix the non-Latin characters crash in buildLoa (embed a Unicode font with fontkit, or sanitise the fields and return a 400).
Prevent a double order or double charge for the same number when 2 requests arrive at once (unique partial index or atomic claim). Refund if the insert fails.
Fix the cancel notification text (refund stated twice, wrong 'couldn't be set up' wording).
Point the hosted SMS inbox link to /app/texting.
Call refreshSummary after pay, send and cancel on the Texting page.
Auto-scroll the thread to the newest message, and fix the QuickReply cost hint for hosted numbers.
critical_code_review_comments: hosted-sms.js init() is guarded by `if (S) return api`, so whichever init runs first wins (_index.js with bot-aware tell, or the web routes). Both tell functions route web ids to notify.push, so it works, but the logic is duplicated.
onInbound for a paused number returns true and drops the text silently. It isn't stored, so the customer never sees what they missed. Consider logging it as undelivered.
reject() uses `r?.value || r` to support both driver versions. That works, but it should be pinned to the installed mongodb driver's return shape.
loa-preview doesn't check status, so it builds an LOA for any order the user owns, including active or cancelled ones. Harmless, but it could be limited to verify/documents.

success_rate.backend: 91% (10/11 pytest; the failure is the non-Latin LOA 500)
success_rate.frontend: 100% of the listed flows work; 3 minor UX issues

rca of the issue: The LOA 500 comes from pdf-lib StandardFonts.Helvetica and TimesRomanBoldItalic, which only encode WinAnsi (CP1252). page.drawText throws on any character outside it. Reproduce: POST /hosted-sms/<id>/loa-preview with {holder:{name:'王伟',...}} → 500, and the nodejs log shows 'WinAnsi cannot encode'. Mitigation: pdf.registerFontkit(fontkit) plus an embedded Noto TTF, or sanitise the fields to WinAnsi.
